what.text: This page follows refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1040 refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in Germany, 4.2% of all refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Serbia and Kosovo is the largest host of refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina, followed by France and Denmark.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Bosnia-Herzegovina from 1992 to 1995, over Serb, Croat and Bihaca Krajina territory.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1994 to 1997, overlap the end of those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at its highest figure, 350000 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
